description:
Perform a vector overlay intersection to split road lines at polygon zone boundaries.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the line layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_lines.geojson.
3. Load the polygon layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson.
4. Open the Intersection tool (Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Intersection).
5. Set the Input layer to sample_lines.
6. Set the Overlay layer to sample_polygon.
7. Run the tool.
8. The result should show the roads split where they cross the zone boundaries, with attributes from both layers attached.
9. Export the result layer to a new file: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/roads_by_zone.geojson (Format: GeoJSON).
